title: Dataplex: Data Product Insights & Breaking Schema Changes
summary: Dataplex introduces new read-only fields for generated data product documentation and asset insights. Developers should be aware that several newly exposed properties are immutable. Additionally, the batch metadata change request now supports deferred validation, and `lookupEntryLinks` scopes have been refined.
details:
Dataplex introduces several new properties that are explicitly marked as read-only, which the API considers a breaking change. Specifically, the `dataProductResult` property within `GoogleCloudDataplexV1DataDocumentationResult`, along with its nested `assetDescriptions`, `overview`, and `queries` fields, are now immutable. Similarly, the `overview` and `resource` properties within `GoogleCloudDataplexV1DataDocumentationResultDataProductResultAssetDescription`, and the `entryGroupType` in `GoogleCloudDataplexV1Entry`, are also read-only. Developers attempting to write to these newly introduced fields will encounter errors.

These new read-only fields enable a new capability for generated insights, providing detailed overviews, asset descriptions, and sample queries for data products and their constituent assets. This enhances the `DataDocumentationResult` schema with valuable, automatically generated metadata.

Further enhancements include the `GoogleCloudDataplexV1RequestBatchMetadataChangeRequest` now supporting an optional `deferredValidation` boolean field. This allows for structural validation at submission, with reference validation deferred until the change request is approved and applied. Additionally, the `projects.locations.lookupEntryLinks` method has refined its authentication scopes, changing one existing scope from `dataplex.read-write` to `cloud-platform.read-only` and adding new `dataplex.read-write` and `dataplex.readonly` scopes. Review your client's scope configuration for this method to ensure continued functionality. The `entryGroupType` has also been added to `GoogleCloudDataplexV1Entry` and `type` to `GoogleCloudDataplexV1EntryGroup`, indicating support for `context-set` EntryGroup types.
